title: Apparatus and method for performing at least one geometric dimension of an object

features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
features.note: The reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, which includes gripping means and optical means, but does not mention a vacuum generating device or a housing with a grip portion for gripping in the context of a vacuum device.

features.item: The grip portion is a hollow body
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion as a hollow body. It mentions 'gripping means (5)' but provides no structural details about it being hollow.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device, exhaust air, or guiding exhaust air through a grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-damping device or any such device arranged in a grip portion.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with these specific combined features, particularly the vacuum generator, exhaust routing, and sound-damping device.

features.item: A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
features.note: The reference describes a device for geometric measurement, not a vacuum handling apparatus with a suction plate or the specified grip unit components.

features.item: The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not describe any grip portion being lined with sound-damping material.

features.item: The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference does not mention a vacuum generating device or its arrangement within a housing portion.

features.item: A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device or lining in any housing portion.

features.item: The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between housing portions with an air outlet.

features.item: An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw, exhaust air, or its arrangement relative to a grip portion or housing.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe air baffles, exhaust air, or guiding exhaust air in relation to a grip portion.

features.item: A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point, air baffles, or directing exhaust air away from such a point.

features.item: The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit and suction plate, nor their releasable connection via a coupling device.

features.item: The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit with a suction opening connected to a suction chamber or suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.

This reference describes a gripping means for moving an object for measurement, but not a housing with a grip portion for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.

This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with housing portions and air outlets.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with an air collection device or air collection screw.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point.
The reference does not mention air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
The reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
The reference does not mention a suction plate, carrier plate, or a seal fastened to a carrier plate.
The reference describes a device for geometric measurement, not a grip unit as described in claim 1 of the subject invention.

This reference does not disclose a grip unit and a suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device. The gripping means described are general and do not specify a suction plate or a coupling device.

claims.quote: said gripping means ( 5 ) comprise at least one retention system with suckers or pneumatic vacuum.
claims.note: The reference mentions a retention system with suckers or pneumatic vacuum, which implies a suction opening and vacuum generation. However, it does not explicitly describe a suction opening being fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate to generate a vacuum between the suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object using gripping means and optical means, which is entirely unrelated to a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit, vacuum generator, and sound-damping features.
